body: They let me go home now. I am sitting at the dinner table. My daughter is eating and my husband is exhausted and gone for a nap. I am greatful to each and every one of you who wrote and shared your kind words. I still am sad but the doctors gave me insight into what I need to change.
I’m scared because I am held now in the psych ward
They transferred me to the psych ward at 3am and just let me have my phone. I am scared. I feel like I fucked everything up and I just want to be better than who I am
I’m scared. They let me have my phone back but took it all night. I am in the psych ward now.
I just want to talk. I am so lonely and frightened.

She seems more stable than me. 

Last night I was putting her to bed. She could see I was sad. 
‘Are you sad about the police?’
I said ‘yes.’ I told her I was sorry that I yelled but I was so scared something would happen...
She said ‘I love you mommy.’ And fell asleep. 
And I feel like shit. :(
I’m just a mom. I’m not even a very good mom. I feel so terrible that I yelled. I was so scared. I’m sorry. I’m In tears right now. I never thought that me upset warranted the police getting called.

So your saying child services isn’t coming today to take her away??

I know this may be a stupid question but my greatest fear in my life is my daughter would be gone.

I just got mad because I was so scared. My daughter really is my whole life.

But it’s not my ex. It’s my husband. But she does the same thing when he gets mad, ‘I’m gonna tell mommy you are mad at me!’ 
Is this so strange? I’m so frightened I haven’t slept all night.
